name: Shimshai
bio: Shimshai was the scribe who, with Rehum and other Persian officials in Samaria, wrote to King Artaxerxes accusing the Jews rebuilding Jerusalem of restoring a rebellious city. When Artaxerxes ordered the work stopped, Shimshai and Rehum hurried to Jerusalem and forced the builders to cease by force, halting the temple's reconstruction until the reign of Darius (Ezra 4:8-24).
